title: feat(nm2oreadz): neighbor-read of O at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: Two-axis opposite seed, z-probes, neighbor-read of O: hold only at A, fail at B,C,D - the exact complement of the M-read pattern in #7363 at every probe. The single A HOLD comes from the partner seed sharing O={+e_1,-e_1,+e_3}.
